description: This Java class defines test step implementations for batch API operations in the Apache Fineract project. It includes methods to construct batch requests for creating clients, loans, charges, approving loans, disbursing, and other loan-related operations, then executing these requests via the BatchApi. Additionally, it contains validation methods to verify the responses, check error codes, transaction details, and ensure correct system behavior under various scenarios, including transactional and idempotent cases.

classes.name: BatchApiStepDef
classes.description: A class providing step definitions for testing batch API operations in Fineract, including creating requests, executing batch calls, and verifying responses.

methods.name: runSampleBatchApiCall
methods.description: Executes a sample batch request sequence that creates a client, creates a loan, charges the loan, and retrieves charge data, then stores the response in context.

methods.name: runBatchAPIWithIdempotencyKey
methods.description: Performs a batch request sequence including client creation, loan creation, approval, disbursement, and repayment with an idempotency key, verifying idempotency behavior.

methods.name: runBatchApiClientLoanApproveLoanDetails
methods.description: Runs batch requests for creating a client and loan, approving the loan, and fetching details, with optional enclosing transaction.

methods.name: runBatchApiClientLoanApproveLoanDetailsApproveFails
methods.description: Runs a similar batch sequence where an approval step is designed to fail for testing error handling.

methods.name: runBatchApiTwiceClientLoanApproveLoanDetails
methods.description: Executes batch requests twice with same data to test idempotency and duplicate handling.

methods.name: runBatchApiTwiceClientLoanApproveLoanDetailsSecondApproveFails
methods.description: Runs duplicate batch requests with a failing approval in the second sequence to test rollback/error handling.

methods.name: runBatchApiClientLoanApproveLoanDetailsApproveDoubled
methods.description: Performs duplicate approval requests to test idempotency for approval operations.

methods.name: runBatchApiCreateAndApproveLoanReschedule
methods.description: Creates and approves a loan reschedule request and then verifies the due date update.

methods.name: runBatchApiCreateAndApproveLoanRescheduleWithGivenUser
methods.description: Creates a user, creates a loan, reschedules, and approves reschedule with user authorization, then verifies the change.

methods.name: runBatchApiCreateAndApproveLoanRescheduleWithGivenUserLockedByCobError
methods.description: Performs reschedule with user context, expects error responses which are validated.

methods.name: runBatchApiQueryDatatableUpdateDatatable
methods.description: Runs batch requests to query and update datatables, checking for empty query responses.

methods.name: runBatchApiCallWithChargeOffCommand
methods.description: Creates a charge-off transaction on a loan within a batch request, then verifies the transaction.

methods.name: runBatchApiWithInterestPauseByExternalIds
methods.description: Creates loan, disburses, approves, and applies interest pause through external IDs.

methods.name: runBatchApiWithInterestPause
methods.description: Runs batch operations including creating, approving, disbursing, and applying interest pause with commands.

methods.name: checkLoanChargedOff
methods.description: Verifies that a loan has a charge-off transaction on a specific date.

methods.name: runBatchApiWithChargeOffCommand
methods.description: Creates a charge-off transaction on a loan within a batch request, then verifies the transaction.

methods.name: verifyInterestPausePeriod
methods.description: Validates that the interest pause period on a loan matches expected start and end days, including retrieving loan details and asserting dates.
